description.en: Sets one participant of the next skill scene: the character para_cpNNNN (NNNN = _face) with the given kit. It calls CMND_SETUP_SKL_SQ_CHARA(_side, _index, 1, ...). The shirt number is ignored for uniforms 900 and above.
Side of the skill scene: "ATK" (attacking side) or "DEF" (defending side).
Participant number on that side, starting at 1.
Character number NNNN of para_cpNNNN, e.g. 8.
Uniform (kit) number, e.g. 1, or 901 for a special outfit.

examples.case: Two attackers in special outfits (real usage, from ev42019997.nut)
